note: One spec for success and failure. The dose record is required on every path; each stage's records (search journal and telemetry, structural record, selection, recovery config/log/product identity, eval-set-1 report, generations and per-item rows) are pulled by the launcher's poll hook as the stage finishes and are optional here (an early failure legitimately produced none). Checkpoints are NOT collected: the materialized states, the Top-1 and the recovered student live on the network volume and are named by sha256 in the records (P8.4).
